sahneler.metin: On Storm King Mountain in Colorado, a wildfire suddenly exploded uphill.
It overran firefighters, and fourteen of them were killed.
For days, the fire had burned only a few acres.
Crews built a fireline downhill from the ridge.
A jumper in charge raised safety concerns.
Red flag warnings had been issued.
A cold front arrived and the fire surged.
Wildland firefighter safety rules were reshaped.

aciklama:
